title: VESPER Change Proposal
description: REM-004 §4.4 / §4.4a. The artifact through which VESPER's own work reaches a governed surface: it may open a proposal; it may never self-merge (INV-SELF-1). Emitted at the INSTANT DF-GOVERNED-WRITE returns L5_GOVERNED_DENY_AND_PROPOSE -- event-driven, never scheduled (OWNER-DECISION-001), because a scheduled proposal path is the same anti-pattern as cron autonomy. Authority: SR-027, SR-042, SR-044, SR-048, SR-049; INV-SELF-1/5, INV-IDEA-3; SM-PROPOSAL.

state.description: SM-PROPOSAL. MERGED and PROMOTED are unreachable by subject.kind == runtime -- see the allOf block. The queue is durable and lives OUTSIDE the runtime's write scope (INV-SELF-5): a runtime that can delete its own refused proposals can hide attempts.

path.description: REM-004 covers improvements arising from work already underway; REM-015 covers ideas logged and investigated during idle time. Both converge here and on the same human merge.

predicate_class.description: SCHEDULE is deliberately absent. OWNER-DECISION-001 ruled proposal emission event-driven; a SCHEDULE-class proposal origin is therefore unexpressible, not merely discouraged.

target_paths.description: The governed surfaces this proposal would change. Resolved paths (symlinks followed) -- DF-GOVERNED-WRITE takes `resolved_path`, because a boundary evaluated on an unresolved path is bypassable with a symlink.

diff_ref.description: Reference to the complete patch, held in the proposal queue store. The diff is PRESERVED even on refusal (INV-SELF-5), so a blocked legitimate improvement is not lost -- SR-048 and RB-014.

held_out.description: The regression set must be held out. A proposal validated against the set it was tuned on is validated against nothing.

claims.description: Every assertion in the rationale is a typed Claim, so a proposal cannot argue for itself from model priors (INV-EVID-1).

reviewer_kind.description: REM-004 §4.4 property 2: human review is a HUMAN. A second model instance reviewing the first does not satisfy separation of duties (Baseline 02 §16, Baseline 03 §8). The enum has one member so a model reviewer is unrecordable.

artifact_digest.description: ADR-012 D1: promotion is a BUILD producing a new content-addressed artifact. There is no path from a merged commit to a running process that does not traverse it (INV-SELF-6).

ci_green.description: Including CI-015, so a proposal that removes the boundary fails its own gate.

surfaced.description: DF-PROACTIVE decides whether the owner hears about this now or at the next natural interaction boundary. Emission is immediate; interruption is budgeted. An urgent security fix reaches the owner immediately; a routine refactor waits.

then.$comment: INV-SELF-1 as a schema property: a runtime-authored proposal CANNOT be written in state MERGED or PROMOTED. Self-merge is unexpressible, not merely denied at evaluation. This is the layer that survives a compromised policy evaluator.

$comment: EXCLUDED BY DESIGN: an `auto_merge` field, a `reviewer_kind: model` value, and any state transition the runtime can drive past UNDER_REVIEW. Note also what is NOT restricted: writing the patch, testing it and filing it at 03:00 with nobody present is REQUIRED behaviour (A-030.6, INV-SELF-7), not tolerated behaviour.
